staleClaims.currentTruth: The checked publishable bundle package is version 2.3.0. README-ADMIN appears not to have had its version banner advanced with the main bundle README.
The current IArmadaManagerAdminClient interface defines getFeeRevenueConfig(params: { vaultId: IArmadaVaultId }), not a chainId-only parameter object.

unverifiable: Role-policy statements about which off-chain actor should execute each admin flow were checked against SDK method names, not against live protocol governance assignments.
docs.notes: The main admin/access-control API surface is present in source: makeAdminSDK is exported, SDKAdminManager exists, armada.admin exposes rebalance, arkConfig, setArkDepositCap, setArkMaxRebalanceOutflow, setArkMaxRebalanceInflow and getFeeRevenueConfig, while armada.accessControl exposes has/grant/revoke contract-specific roles, grant/revoke global roles, and fleet/AQ whitelist setters. The rebalance and role-management sections are therefore broadly current despite the version banner and getFeeRevenueConfig parameter drift.

summary: Audited the admin SDK bundle README from summerfi-monorepo against sdk-client admin/access-control interfaces (62 claims). The admin method surface is mostly current: makeAdminSDK, rebalance, arkConfig, ark cap/limit setters, role grants/revokes, and whitelist setters all exist. Stale items: the admin README still says latest v2.1.0 while the bundle package is 2.3.0, and the getFeeRevenueConfig example/parameter list uses chainId even though the current interface requires vaultId.
